method: Human-visible image inspection after native rendering, a close-up comparison of the rebuilt S3 with the user-supplied Grayhill 25L photograph (not retained), and a pixel comparison of every view with revision 18. Hashes pin the reviewed images.

comparison_with_revision_18.rear: 0 of 2,520,000 pixels differ by more than 24 (max 0)
comparison_with_revision_18.exploded: 0 of 2,520,000 pixels differ by more than 24 (max 22)
comparison_with_revision_18.control_side: 8,770 of 2,520,000 pixels differ by more than 24 (max 208): the round drum, green output board and relocated non-turn tab of S3 and S4
comparison_with_revision_18.io_terminals_detail: 15,129 of 1,350,000 pixels differ by more than 24 (max 94); this view varies by about 15,000 pixels between renders of unchanged geometry

observations: The rebuilt switch matches the photograph: square base with a round drum top and two lock lugs, the white 8-4-2-1-C label band, a green output board with gold lands and solder joints, and the light flatted shaft.
An early build showed a dark line on the label where KiCad tessellates the band in 12-degree facets; the label was thickened to 0.17 mm and the line is gone.
The non-turn tab now sits on the centre line opposite the pins and clears the top panel; the only S3/S4 overlaps are the shafts inside their knobs, unchanged from revision 18.
The four MT holes remain empty, as the BOM part has no bracket.
limitations: Drum, lugs, label and board colour are photo-derived proportions; images do not qualify physical assembly fit.
